description: This PHP class implements runtime methods for inheritance management within the Smarty templating engine, including methods for initializing inheritance, handling child templates, processing blocks, and managing inheritance stack states.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Inheritance
classes.description: A class managing the runtime inheritance state and block processing for Smarty templating, including methods for initializing inheritance, ending child templates, processing blocks, and invoking parent/child blocks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes inheritance for a Smarty template, setting up internal state, source objects, and handling nested inheritance scenarios.

methods.name: endChild
methods.description: Handles the end of a child template, managing output buffers and possibly triggering rendering of the parent template.

methods.name: instanceBlock
methods.description: Creates or retrieves block objects for template inheritance, processing nested or outer level blocks.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a block, handling rendering or inheritance logic, including calls for parent or child blocks.

methods.name: callChild
methods.description: Render the child block if it exists.

methods.name: callParent
methods.description: Render the parent block or throw an error if illegal usage.

methods.name: callBlock
methods.description: Render a block within its associated template source, managing source context stack.
